title: Clarify research scope and a shared example project brief
body:
## Goal
Evaluate every approach against the same needs.

## Scope
Review the requirements and draft a shared customer-management API/UI brief without selecting technology in advance.

## Acceptance criteria
- Users, scenarios, scope, and non-goals are explicit.
- Functional needs and operational expectations are distinguished.
- Unknowns and assumptions are visible.
- Technology/framework choices remain open until justified.

## Output
A project brief draft and shared comparison scenario.

title: Compare BMad Method, AWS AI-DLC, and Spec Kit
body:
## Goal
Evaluate existing methods against requirements R01–R14.

## Dependency
RES-001.

## Acceptance criteria
- Record each method's release or commit identity.
- Answer research/comparison-criteria.md against the same example.
- Distinguish built-in support, required integrations, and unverified claims.
- Compare responsibilities, artifacts, human decisions, and process cost.
- Do not treat untested framework claims as measured results.

## Output
A sourced comparison and justified candidates; implementation selection remains open.

title: Backend standard v0.1: shared rules, Python/.NET/Go, tests, and delivery
body:
## Goal
Define shared backend rules, language profiles, verification, and responsibilities for agents adopting the method.

## Acceptance criteria
- Shared architecture, API, security, data, error, and operations rules.
- Python, .NET, and Go profiles with explicit tool choices and command templates.
- Local, CI, independent review, and smoke responsibilities; real-result and zero-test policy.
- Test case matrix and candidate-bound Definition of Done.
- Planner decomposition, Coordinator dispatch, exclusive coding ownership, and separate review contracts.
- Project/task/evidence templates, with incomplete defaults visibly blocked or draft.
- Distinguish sourced principles, vendor observations, and our decisions.
- Bind commands and enforcement to real code/dependencies in the first backend pilot.
- Demonstrate failures for violations, missing/stale evidence, and zero executed tests.

## Status
GitHub issue #3 owns status. This entry records the task definition only.

title: Research developer, CI, independent review, and release verification gates
body:
## Goal
Make verification responsibilities and evidence explicit from local development to release.

## Current draft
Backend test case matrix, Definition of Done, and delivery workflow are in PR #6; operational enforcement remains untested.

## Acceptance criteria
- Explain unit, real integration, contract, UI component, E2E, and smoke scope.
- Separate developer verification from independent acceptance review.
- Link acceptance cases, reports, source/base/candidate revisions, and artifact identity.
- Handle skipped, flaky, unavailable, and zero-test outcomes explicitly.
- Justify coverage/test-double policy with sources.
- Pilot a verifier that rejects failed/missing/stale evidence and unresolved blockers.

## Output
A tested verification and delivery contract, with UI-specific work tracked separately when designed.

title: Design GitHub repository provisioning and task dispatch contracts
body:
## Goal
Define how a new project brief becomes the correct repository and bounded tasks.

## Dependencies
RES-001 and findings from RES-002.

## Current draft
Backend delivery workflow and task packet template are in PR #6. No dispatcher or repository provisioning automation is running.

## Acceptance criteria
- Define owner/organization, naming, visibility, and repository strategy inputs.
- Link requirements, decisions, dependencies, acceptance cases, and evidence in task packets.
- Distinguish Planner decomposition from Coordinator assignment and state evaluation.
- Define authoritative task state, exclusive claims, retries, expiry, and recovery.
- Prevent duplicate repository/issue/PR creation on retries.
- Specify scoped task contexts, durable handoffs, budgets, and safe parallelism.
- Verify tool capabilities and account permissions separately.
- Validate the contract in a pilot rather than equating a prompt with enforcement.

## Output
A repository provisioning and task-management contract with demonstrated controls.
